verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page names HIPAA, PCI DSS and GDPR alongside SOC 2 and ISO 27001 on its all-in-one platform. The compliance-platform page says a control mapped once counts for every framework, and the docs describe adding and removing frameworks with shared controls kept. The evidence is mostly a marketing-level list, though, with no first-party docs on control sets, templates or audit workflows for HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS. Missing for 10: framework-specific documentation for HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS (controls, policies, evidence mapping), and independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-framework use.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.
Map a control once and it counts for every framework.
Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.
Adding the framework again restores its missing default controls.
